mentions.name: Chess Trainer App
mentions.description: An offline chess trainer app that analyzes the user's game data downloaded from their favorite chess platform. It takes a holistic approach, showing exactly where mistakes occur in the opening or middlegame and how those mistakes carry on into gameplay. It is a one-time purchase with no subscription.
mentions.problem: The myriad of existing chess platforms don't offer a holistic approach showing where exactly you make mistakes and how they carry on into your gameplay.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on a chess trainer app. Unlike the myriad of other platforms out there my trainer offers a holistic approach showing you where exactly you make mistakes (in the opening or middlegame) and how they carry on into your gameplay.
It's an offline application, no subscription, one time purchase. Works by downloading your data from your favourite chess platform.
